title: When the going gets tough, Apple hides its numbers
text:
Apple Inc. dropped a bomb on Thursday, however it wasn't the weak forecast for the holiday quarter: It was the truth that it will no longer disclose system sales of its items for investors, as it has for more than a decade.Apple AAPL, reported that unit shipments for the iPhone were flat at 46.9 million systems offered in the fiscal fourth quarter Thursday, then executives in a teleconference said it would be the last time the company provides such information. Financiers must plainly take this as a sign that system sales will decline in the future, and they will not be told.Read MarketWatch's live protection of Apple revenues
Apple's reasoning for the move was absurd. Chief Executive Tim Cook compared calculating the efficiency of a business valued at more than $1 trillion (a minimum of until the stock opens on Friday ) to an individual going grocery shopping.
